description: An eGFR whose effectiveDateTime is date-precision, '2026-09-02'. Identical to egfr-baseline in every other respect. It renders as "2026-09-02"^^xsd:date, not xsd:dateTime. Declared source-only: the reviewer ruled that a date is not an instant, and DR-009 derives that no SULO time node fits, so the record is retained and no semantic time node is emitted. This is the map correctly declining to assert a time it cannot support, not a failure.

temporal_precision.why_not_an_offsetless_timestamp: FHIR R4's dateTime regex makes the timezone offset MANDATORY once a time component is present: the (Z|(\+|-)hh:mm) group sits inside the T-group and is not optional. '2026-09-02T14:00:00' is therefore not a valid R4 dateTime and no fixture can carry it. Verified against the regex in the published R4 definitions bundle (profiles-types.json, StructureDefinition/dateTime, dateTime.value regex extension). The renderer refuses such a value rather than guessing a datatype.
temporal_precision.consequence_for_the_target: Every conformant R4 dateTime that carries a time also carries an offset, so a rule of the form 'emit xsd:dateTimeStamp when an offset is present, xsd:dateTime when it is not' has no negative case at second precision. The real discrimination is precision: dateTime vs date vs gYearMonth vs gYear. See DR-102 Q-A2-6.

expected.outcome_is_proposed_not_settled: source-only here is PROPOSED and pending review item R3, which now carries a row for date-precision effective times. case.json has no first-class field for 'proposed', so it is stated here and in the manifest's value_policy reason text, which is the convention already used for amended/corrected (Q-A2-5). If the integration lead wants a first-class representation, this is the place to add it.
expected.map_outcome_note: Agent 3's egfr-source.v1.shex pins fhir:Observation.effectiveDateTime to { fhir:value xsd:dateTime }, so the map reports source-shape-nonconformant with a TypeMismatch on that element. That agrees with the declared source-only outcome the same way egfr-retracted does, so no coordination change is needed unless Agent 3 would rather the map bind the value and decline to materialize a time node, which produces a different diagnostic.
